chapters.caption: Step block: three steps, 2, 4 and 6 mm high
Last layer of the lowest step: everything is volume hatch (green)
Upskin (one layer): switch from off to on
Minimum width and overlap: keep 0.1 mm each
Same layer: the top of the low step gets upskin hatch (yellow)
Where the next step continues, the volume hatch stays
One layer higher: only the steps above remain, no upskin
Last layer of the middle step: its top is upskin
Top layer of the part: the whole area is upskin
Toolpaths in 3D up to the middle step
